author: Written with the crossover code, before it ever ran. Review and edit these before the first run: once a run exists, they cannot change.
predictions: At one shard and without caching, code mode over A-uncached at list price crosses 1x between 4 and 16 KiB.
Caching moves that crossing by no more than one size step, either way.
From 128 KiB up, A-uncached and A-cached never see the data: every result is over the 25,000 token output limit and goes to a file they cannot open.
A-tool, the direct arm with a server-side filter, is the cheapest arm at every size from 16 KiB up, and answers correctly.
A-files answers correctly at every size, and costs more than code mode from 64 KiB up.
A-raw answers wrongly in at least one of three runs at 256 KiB and above, because it counts rows by reading.
Code mode answers correctly at every size.
